source.task: Harden Adamas bootstrap evidence before changing compiler demand generation
source.producer: codex with Luna Max implementation workers and hostile review
source.bounded_context: Adamas bootstrap harness, run_safe telemetry, and normalized IR comparison

claim.text: The harness rejects stale or mixed stage evidence in its admitted scope, reports incomplete resource observation as unknown, and no longer labels normalized textual IR equality as semantic equality.
claim.scope: fresh local output directories, repository-subdirectory compiler source, ordinary process descendants observable through bounded pgrep or ps probes, and the existing HIR/MIR/LLVM normalizer
claim.decay_trigger: Any source, producer, output, environment fingerprint, manifest schema, process-probe availability, or IR normalization change

evidence.signal: 5 examples pass; stale exit-zero output and reused directories fail closed while manifests bind stage lineage
9 examples pass; complete fake trees aggregate parent and child, malformed or partial probes become unknown, and timeout cleanup leaves no observed orphan
6 examples pass; stale IR artifacts and stage-hash mismatches are rejected and normalized equality is labeled IR_SHAPE_EQ
ROBUST for the scoped fresh-artifact, complete-tree telemetry, and IR-label claims; non-hermetic environment, endpoint races, detached processes, and sub-sample spikes remain typed residuals
52 runtime examples pass with zero failures or errors

dod_commands: bash -n scripts/bootstrap_chain.sh scripts/build_bootstrap_stages.sh scripts/emit_bootstrap_ir.sh scripts/compare_bootstrap_stages.sh scripts/run_safe.sh
verification.dod_signal: 5 bootstrap, 9 runtime, and 6 IR-script examples pass with shell syntax and whitespace checks clean.

residual_risk: Environment values are fingerprinted but not hermetically isolated. Endpoint hashes miss A-to-B-to-A and between-check replacement races. Resource sampling and PID enumeration can miss sub-interval spikes or short-lived children, and detached processes can escape the observed tree. IR_SHAPE_EQ is normalized textual evidence only. No s2b-to-s5b bootstrap result is claimed.
